plain.li: {X_nameDef} showed me a trick with onions I'd never seen. Years of cooking, and I felt like a child holding the spoon wrong.
Traded kitchen secrets with {X_nameDef}. I'm trying {X_possessive} first thing tomorrow.
[winter] {X_nameDef} says where {X_pronoun} comes from they bury cabbages in the snow and dig them up sour in spring. I've buried six behind the kitchen to try it.
[trait:Gourmand] {X_nameDef} let me taste a sauce made from scraps I'd have thrown to the pigs. I've thought about little else since.
[lowmood] Rotten week. Then {X_nameDef} showed me how to fry bread in a hot pan with a smear of fat, and for ten minutes the world was all right.
Argued with {X_nameDef} all afternoon about seasoning. Best afternoon I've had in weeks.
[rain] Rained all day, so {X_nameDef} and I stayed in the kitchen and cooked our way through half the larder. We ate well tonight.
[morning] {X_nameDef} was in my kitchen before dawn, kneading dough. I was annoyed until the bread came out.
[large] With this many mouths to feed, {X_nameDef}'s way with the stockpot will save me an hour a day.
[skill:Plants] {X_nameDef} pointed out three herbs I'd been pulling up as weeds. They're going in the soup now.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} wouldn't leave the kitchen until I'd folded the dumplings right three times. I hope someone on the road feeds {X_objective} as well as {X_pronoun} fed me today.
I gave {X_nameDef} a bag of my flatbread for the road. It felt right to send a bit of this place along.
[highmood] {X_nameDef} wrote my dumplings into {X_possessive} book of recipes from the road. Someone far from here will be eating them one day.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef}'s recipe is better than mine. That goes in here and nowhere else.
Told {X_nameDef} the soup was bland, then wrote the recipe down.

cheerful.li: New recipe from {X_nameDef}! Honey and meat in the same pot. I'm making it tomorrow.
[summer] {X_nameDef} showed me how to cook berries down so they keep through winter! I've filled four jars already.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} taught me {X_possessive} grandmother's stew. The grandmother died in a famine, {X_nameDef} said. That explains why it uses so little meat.
[winter] Learned a new dish from {X_nameDef}. Mostly roots, boiled a long time. Roots are what we've got.

cold.li: [fall|winter] {X_nameDef} gave me a way to cure meat that will stretch our winter stores by a week. Worth more than anything a trader has ever sold us.
{X_nameDef} talked the whole time {X_pronoun} cooked. I wrote down the amounts while {X_pronoun} wasn't looking.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} is my best friend. {X_nameDef} is leaving soon with {X_possessive} people. I don't think that's fair, and I said so, loudly.
Me and {X_nameDef} found a dead beetle as big as my hand. We buried it with honors. {X_nameDef} did the speech.
[rain] It rained all day so {X_nameDef} and I made a fort out of blankets and the big table. We ate lunch in it.
[winter] Snowball war with {X_nameDef}. My hands went red and then I couldn't feel them at all.
[newcomer] I'm new here and {X_nameDef} is new everywhere, all the time. We agreed to be new together.
{X_nameDef} knows a song about a goat with a terrible secret. I know it now too. The grown-ups don't like it.
[summer] {X_nameDef} and I sat in the stream until our toes went wrinkly. {X_nameDef} wants to be a trader when {X_pronoun} grows up. I want to be a bear.
[morning] {X_nameDef} woke me up by throwing pebbles at the shutters. We were outside before any of the grown-ups were up.
[storm] There was thunder, and {X_nameDef} wasn't scared at all, so I tried not to be either.
[highmood] {X_nameDef} says I'm the funniest person in the whole world. {X_nameDef} has been to a lot of places, so it's probably true.

warm.li: I gave {X_nameDef} my second-best rock so {X_pronoun} won't forget me on the road. It's a very good rock.
{X_nameDef} was scared of our big animals, so I held {X_possessive} hand past the pens. I was a bit scared too, but I didn't say.
[grieving] I told {X_nameDef} about who we lost. {X_nameDef} didn't say anything, just gave me half a sweet and sat with me.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} cheats at tag. I let {X_objective} anyway. Only because {X_pronoun}'s a guest.
{X_nameDef} said our colony smells. It does. I still pushed {X_objective} in the mud.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} can whistle with two fingers! We practiced all day and I can almost do it with one.
We made a secret club, me and {X_nameDef}. It has a password, and I'm not allowed to write it down!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} told me about the place {X_pronoun} lived before. It got burned. {X_nameDef} said it like it was nothing. I don't think it was nothing.
[afterraid] {X_nameDef} asked if raiders come here a lot. I said only sometimes. I don't think {X_pronoun} believed me.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is useful. {X_nameDef} knows where {X_possessive} people keep the sweets.
I let {X_nameDef} win at stones so {X_pronoun} would like me. It worked.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} laughed at my boomalope joke, the one the others groan at. I might be in trouble.
[clear] Sat on the wall with {X_nameDef} until the stars came out. We didn't talk about anything important.
[night] {X_nameDef} will be asleep by now. I'm not.
[trait:Abrasive] {X_nameDef} called me rude and then sat closer.
[spring] A warm evening and a stranger with a nice laugh. Visitors never stay long, I know.
{X_nameDef} touched my arm when {X_pronoun} laughed. Twice. I counted.
[trait:Ugly] {X_nameDef} looked right at my face and smiled. I had to check there wasn't someone standing behind me.
[evening] The sun went down, and {X_nameDef} and I kept talking until somebody yelled at us to put the fire out.
[highmood] Even the beans tasted good today. I know why, and the reason is leaving soon.
[old] I didn't think anyone flirted with people my age. {X_nameDef} did, and I'm still smiling about it.

warm.li: I hope {X_nameDef} gets wherever {X_pronoun}'s going safely. I hope the road brings {X_objective} back this way.
{X_nameDef} asked about my scar and listened to the whole story.

blunt.li: Flirted with a visitor. It went fine. Shut up.
{X_nameDef} has nice hands and terrible jokes. I'd put up with the jokes.
[hurt] {X_nameDef} said the bandages suit me. Liar. I'll take it.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} smiled at me twice at supper! I'm sure the second one was on purpose.
I told {X_nameDef} {X_pronoun} had eyes like a sunset, and {X_nameDef} said "red?" and we laughed for ten minutes!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} will be gone soon, and I'll still be here mucking out the same pens.
[lowmood] For one evening {X_nameDef} made me forget this place. Then the evening ended.
[winter] A cold night and good company. The company will be gone long before the thaw.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} was charming. I was more charming. A pleasant evening that cost me nothing.
{X_nameDef} is attractive and leaves soon. The ideal arrangement.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} knew my name before I said it. Apparently they talk about me on the road. I don't know whether to be proud or start sleeping with a knife.
There's a story going around about me. {X_nameDef} told it. I was taller in it, and I killed more people.
[afterraid] We'd barely washed the blood off when {X_nameDef} asked if I was the one from the stories. After this week, maybe I am.
[trait:Wimp] {X_nameDef} says I'm famous for my bravery. I fainted at a splinter last month. I didn't correct {X_objective}.
[old] {X_nameDef} said {X_possessive} father used to tell stories about me when {X_pronoun} was small. I felt every one of my years.
[newcomer] I've barely been here a season and the road already has a song about me. Three verses, and two of them rhyme.
{X_nameDef} wanted to shake my hand. Then {X_nameDef} wanted to shake it again, for a friend who couldn't come.
[large] All these people here, and {X_nameDef} picked me out by name.
[hurt] {X_nameDef} looked at my bandages and asked if they were from the stories. I said yes. They aren't.
[trait:Abrasive] {X_nameDef} says I'm known for my temper. Fair. I'm also known for being right, which {X_nameDef} left out.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} said the stories about me give people hope out there. I'll have to try to deserve that.
I hope whatever {X_nameDef} heard about me was the kind part.

blunt.li: Apparently I'm famous. Doesn't make the latrine dig itself.
{X_nameDef} got half the story wrong. I let it stand.

cheerful.li: I'm in a song! {X_nameDef} sang it for me. I come in at the second verse and fight a bear, which I have never done.
Someone on the road knows who I am! I waved at {X_nameDef} every time I walked past.
[highmood] {X_nameDef} asked me to scratch my mark on {X_possessive} walking stick! I drew a muffalo.

gloomy.li: If they know my name out there, so do the raiders. Thanks, {X_nameDef}.
{X_nameDef} told me the story they tell about me. Everyone in it dies except me. That part's true.
[grieving] {X_nameDef} asked about the others in the story. Some of them aren't here anymore. The song doesn't know that yet.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} says my name is known along the trade roads. That will keep some raiders away, and get us better prices.
{X_nameDef} recognized me. I'd like to know who else does, and what exactly they're saying.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} had better scars than me. I had better stories. We called it even.
{X_nameDef} fought in the same kind of war I did, probably on the other side. Didn't matter tonight.
[afterraid] Told {X_nameDef} about the last fight while it was still fresh. {X_nameDef} listened like a soldier: no questions until the end, and then the right one.
[trait:Bloodlust] {X_nameDef} has killed more people than I have. I'm jealous. I made {X_objective} tell the one about the bridge twice.
[hurt] Showed {X_nameDef} the new wound. {X_nameDef} said it'll heal ugly, and that ugly is the best kind. I'll hold {X_objective} to that.
{X_nameDef} showed me a better way to stand when they come at you in a line. I hope I never need it. I'm practicing anyway.
[winter] Cold night, good fire, and a stranger who knows exactly what I mean when I say I still hear it sometimes.
[old] {X_nameDef} is young enough to be my child and has seen nearly as much as I have. That isn't right.
[night] We talked into the small hours. {X_nameDef} knows that hour too, the one where you can't stop going over it.
[skill:Shooting] {X_nameDef} showed me how {X_possessive} people steady their aim. Breathe out, then shoot in the gap between heartbeats. I'll be trying it all week.
[skill:Melee] {X_nameDef} taught me a feint for a short blade. I'll try it on the woodpile tomorrow, and on someone else after that.

warm.li: We drank to everyone we've lost, {X_nameDef} and me. It took a while. Neither of us rushed it.
I told {X_nameDef} I hope {X_pronoun} never has to fight again. {X_nameDef} said the same about me. Neither of us believed it.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} can fight. I respect that.
{X_nameDef} says {X_possessive} old company would've held our wall better. Well, they aren't here, are they.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} and I acted out a whole battle on the table, with spoons for soldiers and a turnip for the enemy!
{X_nameDef} once fought off a man with nothing but a ladder! I made {X_objective} tell it three times.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} has the same look I have, the one where you're always counting the exits.
We told stories until the fire went out. All of {X_nameDef}'s end with somebody dead. Mine too.
[grieving] We drank to the dead. I had a fresh name to add. {X_nameDef} didn't ask whose, just poured.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} had useful observations on flanking. I'll test them on the next raid.
{X_nameDef} says raiders break when the one in front goes down. I'll remember that.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} talked about a warm sea and fish that jump into the boats. I looked out at our fields for a while afterward.
[winter] Somewhere south it's warm right now. {X_nameDef} has been there. I can't feel one of my ears.
[spring] The roads are open again. {X_nameDef} will be on one soon. I'll be here, with the turnips.
{X_nameDef} has seen a city with a thousand chimneys. I've thought about the chimneys all day, and whoever has to sweep them.
[trait:Undergrounder] {X_nameDef} talked about plains so wide you can see weather coming for three days. Sounds horrible. Glad I'm here, under a good roof.
[small] There are so few of us here, and {X_nameDef} talked about markets with crowds you can get lost in. I'd like to get lost. Just for an afternoon.
I asked {X_nameDef} what's past the mountains. More mountains, {X_nameDef} said, then the sea.
[summer] It's summer here, and it's still not the summer {X_nameDef} described. Theirs has grapes.
[old] Too old to go anywhere now. {X_nameDef} talked about the sea anyway, and for an evening I was twenty and leaving.
[newcomer] I've only just got here, and already {X_nameDef} has me wondering what else is out there. That can't be a good sign.

warm.li: Maybe one day we'll all go and see {X_nameDef}'s warm coast together. I'd like that.
I asked {X_nameDef} to look at the sea for me when {X_pronoun} gets there.
[evening] Walked {X_nameDef} out past the fields at sunset, and we watched the road for a while.

blunt.li: Trader talks too much about places I'll never see. Bought a needle anyway.
Warm sea. Jumping fish. Either {X_nameDef} is lying, or I'm going.

cheerful.li: There's a desert where the sand sings! {X_nameDef} has heard it. I'm going to hear it too, someday.
I'm making a list of every place {X_nameDef} has been! It's up to nineteen.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} told me about places I'll never see. Then {X_nameDef} left to go and see them.
[lowmood] Somewhere out there people are eating fresh fish by a warm sea. Here we're eating whatever the rats left.
[fog] Fog all day, and {X_nameDef}'s warm sea feels like something I dreamed.

cold.li: {X_nameDef}'s descriptions of the southern routes were detailed. Useful, if we ever need to leave in a hurry.
The world is larger than this patch of ground. I'll keep that in mind as an option.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} smiled the whole time {X_pronoun} was cheating me. That's the part I can't get over.
Went back to complain, and {X_nameDef} was suddenly very busy with someone else.
[trait:Greedy] Robbed, by a professional. I'm furious, and I'm writing down exactly how it was done.
[trait:TooSmart] I always check the goods. Today I was in a hurry and didn't.
Paid good silver to {X_nameDef} for rubbish. I should have looked closer.
[rain] Rain all day, and I spent it going over the trade with {X_nameDef} again and again.
[hurt] Hobbled over on my bad leg to complain to {X_nameDef}, and got a shrug for my trouble.
[trait:Abrasive] I told {X_nameDef} exactly what I think of {X_objective}. It took a while. The silver's still gone, but I feel better.
[hot] Stood in the heat arguing with {X_nameDef} until I was dizzy. Got nowhere.
[large] With so many people about, no one else noticed what {X_nameDef} did to me. I noticed.

warm.li: Maybe {X_nameDef} needed the silver more than I did. I'm trying to believe that. It isn't going well.
I wanted to think the best of {X_nameDef}. I'll think the best of the next one, and check the goods.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} is a thief with a cart. If {X_pronoun} comes back, I'm doing the weighing.
Cheated. Me, of all people.
[rain] Wet, cheated and short of silver. {X_nameDef} is lucky the caravan's out of throwing range.

cheerful.li: Got swindled! At least it makes a good story for supper.
Cheated by {X_nameDef}! Well, now I know what a real swindle looks like.

gloomy.li: Raiders, wolves, plague, and now a trader robbing me in broad daylight.
Of course {X_nameDef} cheated me. It's been that kind of week.
[lowmood] One more thing gone wrong this week, courtesy of {X_nameDef}.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} misjudged who to cheat. I've written down the caravan's route and its faction.
It cost me a few silver to learn that {X_nameDef}'s word is worthless. Cheap enough.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} had me turn the bed to face east, then west, then asked why it was so small.
Carried hot water for {X_nameDef} four times today. The water was the wrong temperature four times.
[trait:Ascetic] {X_nameDef} asked how anyone can live like this. I sleep on a plank and I've never been happier. I didn't say so.
[trait:Abrasive] {X_nameDef} called me a servant. I called {X_nameDef} something too. We are both waiting to see who apologizes first.
[small] There's only a handful of us, and {X_nameDef} expects a staff. Today I was the cook, the maid and the guard, and it wasn't even noon.
{X_nameDef} snaps {X_possessive} fingers for service. I've started going deaf at convenient moments.
[rich] We have more than most colonies on this whole continent, and {X_nameDef} still asked whether we're "getting by".
[winter] {X_nameDef} wants a fire in {X_possessive} room day and night. We're chopping wood for a noble while our own fingers freeze.
[hot] Spent the hottest part of the day fanning {X_nameDef}. My arm still aches.
[night] {X_nameDef} called for me at midnight because of an owl. The owl wasn't even inside.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} is rude, but scared, I think. People far from home get rude. I brought the tea anyway.
In among all the demands, {X_nameDef} said thank you once, under {X_possessive} breath.

blunt.li: Nobles. One more day of {X_nameDef} and I'm putting a lizard in the pillow.
{X_nameDef} wanted to know if I'd been "trained". I have. With an axe.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} said my manners were "nearly adequate"! That's the nicest thing {X_pronoun}'s said to anyone.
I've found seven ways {X_nameDef} doesn't like eggs. Tomorrow I'm trying an eighth!
[morning] Brought {X_nameDef} breakfast at dawn and got a whole sentence out of {X_objective} before the complaining started!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} looks at all of us like we're something on {X_possessive} boot.
We risk our necks to keep {X_nameDef} safe, and {X_nameDef} complains about the pillows.
[rain] {X_nameDef} complained the rain was too loud. I offered to have a word with it. {X_nameDef} didn't laugh.

cold.li: I smile at {X_nameDef} every time {X_pronoun} complains. Unpleasant, but well connected.
I've noted everything {X_nameDef} demanded today. When the reward comes, it had better cover it.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} cried into the stew I brought. I sat there and let {X_objective}.
{X_nameDef} sleeps with {X_possessive} shoes on, ready to run. Last night {X_nameDef} took them off. I noticed.
[winter] Gave {X_nameDef} my spare blanket. I'll be cold tonight.
[trait:Kind] {X_nameDef} thanked me for a bowl of stew like I'd handed over a kingdom. I didn't know what to do with my hands.
[grieving] I've lost someone too. I didn't tell {X_nameDef}. I sat with {X_objective} for a while instead.
{X_nameDef} carved me a bird. It looks like a potato with a beak. It's on my shelf, front and center.
[afterraid] After this week I understand better what {X_nameDef} ran from. I'm glad there's a wall between us and them.
[night] {X_nameDef} woke up screaming again. I sat on the floor by the door until {X_pronoun} fell asleep.
[storm] Thunder tonight, and {X_nameDef} went white and grabbed my arm. Only weather, I said. {X_nameDef} said that's what they said last time.
[small] There are so few of us, and we still made room for {X_nameDef}. I'm proud of that.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} has eaten properly two days in a row. That's the best thing I've done all season.
I told {X_nameDef} {X_pronoun}'s safe here. I'll make it true if I have to.
[morning] Brought {X_nameDef} warm porridge first thing. {X_nameDef} ate it slowly, like someone who's learned that food can be taken away.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} keeps thanking me. Stop thanking me. Eat.
Whoever {X_nameDef} is running from can try the gate. I'll be standing behind it.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} smiled today! I've been in a good mood ever since.
I taught {X_nameDef} our dinner song and {X_pronoun} sang along! Badly, but loud.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} said thank you like someone who's had very little to thank anyone for. I know that voice. I used to have it.
We give {X_nameDef} stew and a bed. Whatever chased {X_objective} here is still out there, walking around.

cold.li: I've never seen anyone as grateful as {X_nameDef}. I haven't decided yet what to ask for in return.
{X_nameDef} told me everything about the people chasing {X_objective}. Numbers, weapons, names. Very useful.
[afterraid] The raid didn't seem to surprise {X_nameDef} at all. I'd like to know what else {X_nameDef} hasn't told us.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} told me a piece of {X_possessive} life through the door. It's stayed with me all day.
Sat outside {X_nameDef}'s door longer than I meant to. It's strange, liking someone through a lock.
[night] Can't sleep. {X_nameDef}'s story is still going round my head.
[trait:Kind] {X_nameDef} wasn't born a raider. I'd like to think {X_pronoun} doesn't have to die one.
[afterraid] Hard to listen to {X_nameDef}'s story the same week {X_possessive} kind came over our wall. I listened anyway.
{X_nameDef} told me {X_pronoun} misses {X_possessive} mother's cooking more than being free, and then asked what was for dinner.
[rain] Rain on the prison roof. {X_nameDef} said it sounds like home. I didn't ask where home was. I should have.
[winter] {X_nameDef} says the cell is warmer than the last three places {X_pronoun} slept. I believe {X_objective}.
[grieving] I'm grieving, and so is {X_nameDef}, in {X_possessive} own way. We didn't talk about it. We talked about bread instead.
[evening] Talked with {X_nameDef} through the door until the light went. I don't remember deciding to stay.

warm.li: I want {X_nameDef} to have a second chance. I want us to be the kind of place that gives them.
[evening|night] {X_nameDef} said nobody had asked about {X_possessive} life in years. So I asked. It took all evening.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef}'s got a sad story. Plenty of us have sad stories and didn't take up raiding.
{X_nameDef}'s still a raider, and still locked up. I liked talking to {X_objective} anyway.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} told me a story through the door, a really good one! I think we're friends now.
{X_nameDef} does all the voices when {X_pronoun} tells a story! I laughed so hard the warden glared at me.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} could have been me, with a worse year. Most raiders could. That's the bit I can't put down.
A cell and a cold bowl. That's all {X_nameDef} has right now.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} talks freely now. Every story is another lever. I'm keeping them all.
{X_nameDef} believes I'm sympathetic. Good. That makes recruitment simpler.
[evening] Let {X_nameDef} talk all evening. I learned where {X_pronoun} grew up and who {X_pronoun} misses. Both will help with recruitment.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} knew a song I haven't heard since I was young. I didn't expect to hear it again in this life.
{X_nameDef} and I came up the same hard way. One of us is in a cell now.
[old] {X_nameDef} remembers the old ways too. Hardly anyone does anymore. We talked about them like dead friends.
[winter] {X_nameDef} remembers the winter the river froze solid back home. So do I. We were both there, on different banks.
[trait:Abrasive] I don't like most people. {X_nameDef} grew up as rough as I did, and I don't hate {X_objective}. That's a lot, from me.
[night] I can hear {X_nameDef} humming the old songs in the cell. I hum along from my bed.
{X_nameDef} and I started out in the same place, more or less. I fell in with decent people. {X_nameDef} didn't.
[rain] It used to rain like this back home, {X_nameDef} said. I said I know. We sat and listened to it until supper.
[evening] {X_nameDef} and I spent the evening naming every dish we grew up on. We were both starving by the end.
[newcomer] I'm still new here, and the person who feels most like home is locked in a cell.

warm.li: It's been a long time since anyone knew where I came from without being told. {X_nameDef} does.
I'm going to ask the council to give {X_nameDef} a chance. People like us don't get many.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} is from where I'm from. That doesn't make {X_objective} a friend. It makes {X_objective} close.
Same past, different choices. I'm the one with the keys.
[night] {X_nameDef} wouldn't stop humming, so I hummed back to fix the tune. Now neither of us is sleeping.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} knows the clapping game from my village! We played it through the bars.
I've found someone who swears in my old dialect! We swore at each other until the warden told us to stop.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} and I came out of the same mud. One of us got lucky. I'm not sure it was me.
Most people from back home are dead or raiding now. {X_nameDef} is nearly both.
[lowmood] The only person here who understands where I come from is behind a locked door, and I'm the one who locks it.

cold.li: Shared history makes {X_nameDef} easy to read. I know what {X_pronoun} fears, because I used to fear it.
{X_nameDef} trusts me now, because of where we're from. I'll use that, for the colony's sake and maybe {X_possessive}.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} is behind a door I can lock. I walked past it four times today to make sure it holds.
Looked {X_nameDef} in the eye today. My hands didn't shake until afterward.
[hurt] Still healing from what {X_nameDef} did. {X_nameDef} asked how it was healing. I didn't answer.
[trait:Bloodlust] {X_nameDef} is right there, unarmed, behind one little door. The council had better have a plan. I have several.
[trait:Kind] I hate {X_nameDef}. I brought {X_objective} water anyway. I'm not sure who that was for.
[night] Dreamed {X_nameDef} got out. Went and checked. Still there, asleep. I don't know how {X_nameDef} can sleep.
I can look at {X_nameDef} now. I've been waiting a long time to be able to write that.
[afterraid] Another raid, and none of them came for {X_nameDef}. I enjoyed that more than I should have.
[winter] Cold in the cells tonight. I thought about bringing {X_nameDef} a blanket. I thought about it for a long time.
[trait:Tough] {X_nameDef} tried to stare me down. I've been stared at by worse, and stabbed by {X_objective}. Neither one took.

warm.li: I want to be bigger than what {X_nameDef} did to me. Today I wasn't. Maybe tomorrow.
The others keep asking if I'm all right since {X_nameDef} was brought in. I will be.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef}'s in a cell and I'm not. Good.
Told {X_nameDef} I'd be the last face {X_pronoun} ever sees. Probably shouldn't have. Meant it.

cheerful.li: [evening|night] Cold porridge behind bars for some people tonight. I'm having stew!
I sang every song I know outside {X_nameDef}'s door!

gloomy.li: They caught {X_nameDef}, and I still wake up on the ground in that fight.
I thought it would feel like winning, seeing {X_nameDef} locked up. It feels like a scar that itches.
[lowmood] Even with {X_nameDef} locked up, the bad days are still bad. I thought this would fix more.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is contained. I've begun thinking about what comes after, in detail.
{X_nameDef} remembers me. Good. It's important that {X_pronoun} does.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} was lying in the mud asking for water. I gave {X_objective} some from my own skin.
[hurt] I was bleeding myself when I held the cup for {X_nameDef}. Neither of us said anything about whose fault that was.
[rain] {X_nameDef} was lying face up in the rain, trying to drink it. I rolled {X_objective} onto {X_possessive} side so {X_pronoun} wouldn't drown, then fetched a proper cup.
[trait:Kind] {X_nameDef} came here to kill us. I gave {X_objective} water anyway, and I'd do it again.
[winter] The water in my skin was half ice. {X_nameDef} drank it anyway, and thanked me with blue lips.
[night] Can't sleep. I keep seeing {X_nameDef}'s hands shaking around the cup.
{X_nameDef} said a lot of things while drinking. The worst was "thank you".

warm.li: {X_nameDef} was somebody's child once. I tried to remember that while I held the cup.
I hope someone did the same for our people, on the days we lost. I hope someone held the cup.
[grieving] I've buried enough of our own lately. I didn't want to watch another one go thirsty, even this one.

blunt.li: Gave a raider water. Don't make it a thing.
{X_nameDef} drank half and spilled the other half down my sleeve. Ungrateful, and wet.
[hot] Hot day, and a raider in the dust with a tongue like a boot. I fetched {X_objective} water. I'm not a monster.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} looked up from the mud and said I had a kind face! I've never been told that before.
I gave {X_nameDef} a drink and {X_pronoun} said it was the best water {X_pronoun}'d ever had. It's just water, but I'll take it!
[highmood] Good day. I even gave a raider a drink, and {X_nameDef} looked so surprised I nearly laughed.

gloomy.li: One day it'll be me in the mud, asking a stranger for water. I hope the stranger is like me today, and not like me most days.
Gave {X_nameDef} water. All it did was let {X_objective} hurt longer.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} offered information for water. A fair trade. I took notes.
A grateful enemy is more useful than a dead one. I gave {X_nameDef} water accordingly.
[afterraid] The fight was over, {X_nameDef} was no threat, and water is cheap. A simple calculation.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} pressed a message on me, lying there in the dirt. I don't know yet where to take it.
I promised {X_nameDef} I'd pass the message on. I don't know how I'm going to keep that promise.
[hurt] I was bleeding too when {X_nameDef} grabbed my sleeve and made me listen.
[rain] {X_nameDef} said it so low in the rain that I had to lean right down to hear. My knees are still wet.
[trait:Kind] {X_nameDef} came here to kill us, and I still knelt in the dirt and promised to remember every word.
[night] Lying awake with {X_nameDef}'s words going round and round.
{X_nameDef} thought those were the last words. Maybe they weren't. I've got them now either way.
[grieving] I know what it's like to be the one waiting for news. Somebody out there is waiting for {X_nameDef}'s. I have it.
[fog] {X_nameDef} said it in the fog, and when the fog lifted I half expected the words to be gone too.

warm.li: Someone out there is waiting to hear from {X_nameDef}. I hope the message finds them.
I'll ask every caravan that comes through whether they know where {X_nameDef}'s people are.
[rain] I wrote {X_nameDef}'s words down before the rain could wash them out of my head. They're folded in my coat, dry.

blunt.li: A raider gave me a message. I'm not a messenger. I'll probably pass it on anyway.
{X_nameDef} talked my ear off while bleeding. Some people don't know how to lie still.

cheerful.li: Wrote {X_nameDef}'s message down and tucked it in my boot, the safest place I've got!
{X_nameDef} trusted me with {X_possessive} message! I'm going to get it where it needs to go.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} asked me to carry a message to someone. I already carry a few for people who didn't make it.
If I'm the one in the dirt someday, I don't know who I'd send a message to.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} talked freely from the ground. Names, places, who's waiting for {X_objective}. I took it all down.
Last words are surprisingly informative. {X_nameDef} gave me a name and a place. Filed.
[night] Went over {X_nameDef}'s words again tonight, not out of sentiment. They may be worth something to someone.
